name: AgentFactory
description: AgentFactory is a no-code/low-code platform for building AI agents using a structured Markdown specification format. Instead of writing code or wrestling with YAML configs, you fill in a visual form and get a clean, portable agent spec file that any compatible runtime can execute.

name: web-lens
description: WebLens is a lightweight browser extension that analyzes real-world web page performance directly in your browser using native Web Performance APIs.

name: AgentFactory-CLI
description: A command-line tool for validating AgentFactory .md agent spec files.  It ensures agent definitions are production-ready by detecting structural issues, misspelled keys, missing sections, and insecure credential patterns before deployment.

name: PhoneBook
description: This program for save person details in a data base.
